panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 3 panels (A, B, C). A: The panel shows an axial CT image demonstrating the characteristic consequences of diaphragmatic eventration, including liver displacement and lung compression, which are noted in the figure caption. B: This panel clearly demonstrates the hallmark signs of diaphragmatic eventration: marked, smooth elevation of the right hemidiaphragm while maintaining continuity of the dome, as stated in the caption. C: The panel illustrates the secondary pulmonary consequences of the eventration, including compressive atelectasis and mediastinal shift, confirming the clinical picture of the targeted disease.
